per second | var2 at0 = 5 | var2 at15 = 25}} == Acquisition == '''[[Signet of Capture]]''' * [[Factions]] ** [[Chkkr Brightclaw]] ([[Melandru's Hope]]) * [[Eye of the North]] ** [[Reesou the Wanderer]] ([[Alcazia Tangle]]) == Notes == * The health gain at 12 Restoration Magic equals a [[health regeneration]] of 10.5 [[pip]]s (21 pips within earshot of a spirit) and 13 pips at 16 Restoration Magic (26 pips within earshot of a spirit). * [[Hero]]es will cast Spirit Light Weapon to overwrite non-defensive weapon spells when the target's health is at critical levels. {{bug|Contrary to the concise description, this skill's conditional effect causes health gain and not [[healing]].}} == Trivia == * The [[skill icon]] resembles an axe affected by a [[weapon spell]] which has an ankh - the Egyptian symbol of life - on it. * The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
